subtasks: Hold the pen holder with one hand, place all pens into it with the other hand, then put it back down.

Hold the pen holder upright with the right hand. Regrasp the protruding black pen at its blunt silver-banded end with the left hand, lift it clear, and insert its white conical writing tip down into the holder beside the highlighters.
Pick up the horizontal black pen from the table by its silver-banded end on the right. Turn its white conical writing tip down and insert it into the upright orange holder.
Set the orange holder upright on the table and regrasp it low from the side with the right hand so its opening is clear for the two loose pens.
Keep the orange holder steady in the right hand. Pick up the slim white pen with the left hand and insert it writing tip down into the holder beside the two highlighters.

Pick up the remaining black pen lying directly in front of the orange holder with the left hand. Insert its white conical writing tip down into the holder while the right hand steadies it. Release the holder upright and return both arms home with open grippers.
Set the tilted orange holder upright on the table, preserving the three inserted pens. Fully open both grippers to release it and return both arms to their initial poses.
